answer: Novelty-Gated Inlet Routing: each coordination event crosses an inlet attached to a vertex. Routing credit is an ember that decays on reuse; new peers require a sampled task output checked against a locality-sensitive sketch. Duplicate or near-duplicate outputs yield no ember, and repeated edges throttle. A sybil swarm must produce distinct valid work per identity and keep embers fresh, paying independent compute plus verification latency per coordinated identity, not just registration.
